remarks: Explore the inviting charm of this beautifully appointed 1-bedroom, 1-bath loft-style townhouse situated in the scenic surroundings of Ellicottville. This turn-key property melds comfort and style, providing an ideal retreat for outdoor enthusiasts and those seeking a tranquil getaway. The heart of this townhouse features a spacious open floor plan that beautifully integrates the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The kitchen boasts modern stainless steel appliances alongside stunning granite countertops and a unique river stone backsplash, creating a contemporary yet welcoming atmosphere. Decorative hardwood floors extend throughout the main level, enhancing the warmth and elegance of the space. The living area showcases a large stone-surrounded gas fireplace, perfect for warming up after a day on the slopes or exploring nearby hiking trails. Natural light floods the space through large windows, offering picturesque views of the surrounding slopes, while an inviting spiral staircase leads you to the serene loft bedroom. Here, you’ll find a cozy sleeping space designed for relaxation, complete with ample storage. The living area also features a Murphey bed & fold out couch for additional guests. The property's outdoor space is equally impressive, featuring well-maintained landscaping and an easy walk to the slopes or golf courses of Holiday Valley. You’ll also enjoy proximity to Ellicottville's vibrant scene, featuring charming shops, delightful restaurants, and a variety of recreational activities year-round. This townhouse is not just a home; it is an experience waiting to be lived. With its thoughtful design and prime location, this unit offers a perfect blend of luxury and accessibility for a wide range of active lifestyles. The quarterly HOA payment covers internet and cable TV.
